# Kinship RP

A roleplay addon for World of Warcraft, on retail and on Forever. It keeps your character's profile, your family, the people you've met, what you carry and the stories you're part of in one journal, and tries to fit in with the game's own interface rather than sit on top of it.

It speaks the same profile protocol as Total RP 3, MyRolePlay and XRP, so players using those addons can read your profile and you can read theirs. It also runs happily alongside Total RP 3 if you'd rather keep it.

> Kinship is in beta. If something's broken or confusing, please [open an issue](https://github.com/alexwaddell97/kinship-addon/issues/new/choose).

## What it does

**Your character.** A profile with as much or as little as you like, glances (the details people notice first), personality traits, effects like being bandaged after a fight, and a stage you set out behind your character for when someone opens your profile.

![A profile on its stage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexwaddell97/kinship-addon/main/.github/images/03-on-stage.jpg)

**Quests you write.** Write a quest and offer it to the players around you. Objectives can tick themselves: reaching a place, doing an emote at someone, winning a duel, answering a riddle, finding a hidden stash, and plenty more. Run it as the storyteller and everyone who accepted sees the story move along.

![A quest offer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexwaddell97/kinship-addon/main/.github/images/09-quest-offer.jpg)

**What you wear.** Design your own items, mark them as worn, and put them on: a roleplay slot for every piece of gear on the character screen. Save outfits and change into them with one click, or tie one to a profile. Other Kinship users see what you're wearing.

![The Worn tab](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexwaddell97/kinship-addon/main/.github/images/13-worn.jpg)

**Houses and groups.** Characters who share a family name can form a house with a crest, motto and history. Groups do the same for companies, orders and RP guilds that aren't families.

**RP-PvP.** For roleplay between the factions, Kinship adds a war stance, boundaries for injury, death, capture and crime, a record of rivals and battles, and Parley: a wheel of the game's own emotes that the other faction can see.

**And the rest.** Letters with wax seals, documents, trading items, stashes hidden in the world, gatherings on the calendar, dice, a satchel next to your bags, a Roleplay tab on the character sheet, and a directory of every roleplayer you've met.

## Using it with Total RP 3

You don't have to choose. When both are running, Kinship asks once:

- **Keep both.** Total RP 3 looks after your profile, tooltips, nameplates and target bar. Kinship hides its own versions and adds what Total RP 3 doesn't have. A Kinship button on Total RP 3's target bar shows what someone wears, their house and their stage. If you use Total RP 3: Extended too, you pick which addon looks after items, documents and effects.
- **Move to Kinship.** Your Total RP 3 profiles come across, Total RP 3 is switched off, and the game reloads. Its saved data isn't touched, so you can switch back any time.

Kinship never loads or depends on Total RP 3. It only notices when it's there.

## Installing

Kinship works on retail and on Forever. The easiest way is to install it from CurseForge or [Wago](https://addons.wago.io/addons/kinship-addon) with their apps, which put it in the right folder for your game.

To install it by hand, download the zip from the latest [release](https://github.com/alexwaddell97/kinship-addon/releases/latest) and unzip it into your game's AddOns folder. The same zip works for both:

```
World of Warcraft\_retail_\Interface\AddOns\KinshipRP
World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\KinshipRP
```

The folder must be called `KinshipRP`. If you clone this repository instead, clone it into that folder name:

```
git clone https://github.com/alexwaddell97/kinship-addon.git KinshipRP
```

## Getting started

Type `/kin` to open the journal, or click the minimap button. The first time, Kinship asks how much roleplay you've done before, then offers a short tour of each page (Esc skips them, and the **?** at the top of the journal plays one again).

The **[wiki](https://github.com/alexwaddell97/kinship-addon/wiki)** goes through every feature in more detail.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/kin` | Open your journal |
| `/kin help` | List every command |
| `/kin view` | Your target's profile, or your own |
| `/kin outfit Name` | Change into a saved outfit |
| `/kin roll 2d6+3` | Roll dice |
| `/kin parley` | The Parley wheel |
| `/kin bug` | Details to copy into a bug report |

Key bindings are under Key Bindings > AddOns > Kinship RP.

## Reporting a bug

[Open a bug report](https://github.com/alexwaddell97/kinship-addon/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). It asks for what `/kin bug` shows in game: copy everything in its box and paste it in. That includes Kinship's version and the last errors it caught, which makes things much quicker to track down.

Have an idea instead? [Suggest it here](https://github.com/alexwaddell97/kinship-addon/issues/new?template=idea.yml).

## A note on AI

Kinship is an AI assisted project.

releases.name: Kinship RP v1.4.17
releases.notes:
Theme music that stops on its own, web links you can copy, and a profile
window that keeps your place. No files were added, so a /reload is enough.

### Changed
- "Play their theme" on the target bar stops after 10 seconds instead of
  repeating until you click it again.
- A theme you preview on the Persona page stops when you close the window or
  leave the Look tab.
- Web links in profile text show as a short label instead of the whole
  address. Hover to see where one goes, and click to copy it. This works
  for links written for Total RP 3 ({link*url*text} or [text](https://github.com/alexwaddell97/kinship-addon/blob/main/url)) and for
  plain addresses.

### Fixed
- Reading a long profile no longer jumps back to the top when the profile,
  your auras or your worn items update while it's open.
- Icons and pictures in Total RP 3 players' descriptions show again, instead
  of disappearing or showing as a line of code like "|TInterface\...".
  Kinship checks each one exists and sizes it to fit, as it does for image
  tags.

---
Unzip into your game's `Interface\AddOns` folder (`_forever_` or `_retail_`), so you have an `AddOns\KinshipRP` folder.

releases.name: Kinship RP v1.4.16
releases.notes:
Name colours that follow the game, a choice about the character name, and a
window you can resize. No files were added, so a /reload is enough.

### New
- Settings > Names. "Character name after roleplay names" turns off the grey
  (Character Name) after roleplay names in chat, on unit frames, on the
  target bar and in the character window. Tooltips still show it, and
  nameplates keep their own setting.
- Resize the Kinship window. Drag the grip in its bottom-right corner to make
  it bigger or smaller. Right-click the grip to go back to the normal size.
  The size is kept for all your characters.

### Changed
- "Players' own name colours" has moved from Nameplates to the new Names
  card, as it also covers chat, tooltips and unit frames.

### Fixed
- Roleplay names no longer turn gold when a player hasn't picked a name
  colour, or when players' own colours are off. They keep the game's colour
  instead: class colour in chat, and the usual colour on tooltips,
  nameplates and unit frames.

---
Unzip into your game's `Interface\AddOns` folder (`_forever_` or `_retail_`), so you have an `AddOns\KinshipRP` folder.

releases.name: Kinship RP v1.4.13
releases.notes:
Dark paper for letters, and game mail you can keep with them. No files were
added, so a /reload is enough.

### New
- Dark paper for letters. Choose Light or Dark paper under The paper when
  you write one. The person you send it to sees it on the same paper, if
  they have this version of Kinship. With the Blizzard look, letters start
  on dark paper until you choose.
- Keep ordinary game mail with your letters. Open a mail at the mailbox and
  press Keep it on the Kinship card beside it. A copy goes into your
  Received letters and stays there after the mail is deleted.

### Fixed
- The window that asks about Total RP 3 no longer runs its list into the
  "Or move to Kinship" note below it.
- Settings > General no longer leaves empty space for the Total RP 3 buttons
  when Kinship is your only roleplay addon, and searching no longer lights
  up a button that isn't there.

---
Unzip into your game's `Interface\AddOns` folder (`_forever_` or `_retail_`), so you have an `AddOns\KinshipRP` folder.
